items.title: Oil prices move higher as Iran threatens response to latest U.S. strikes
items.description: Brent crude futures, the international benchmark, gained 1.5% to $92.10 a barrel. U.S. West Texas Intermediate futures advanced 0.9% to $85.23 per barrel.

items.title: Samsung says chip crunch will last until 2028 as quarterly profit soars
items.description: Samsung Electronics extended its record run with second-quarter operating profit topping analysts' estimates.

items.title: Meta tanks nearly 9%, Microsoft jumps 8% as the AI trade splits Big Tech
items.description: Microsoft posted strong Azure and Copilot growth, while Meta missed revenue guidance forecasts as free cash flow plunged leading to diverging stock moves.

items.title: From Hormuz to the Black Sea: Maritime battlefields are shaping ‘a new world order’
items.description: Attacks near the Strait of Hormuz, Red Sea and Black Sea are pushing shipowners to reroute cargo and rethink global trade risks.

items.title: Shell posts best quarterly profit in four years as Iran war boosts oil and gas prices

items.title: Iran says it will 'punish the aggressor today' after 'heavy wave' of U.S. strikes

items.title: Jeep maker Stellantis swings to profit on rising demand in North America; shares fall 5%
